prompt: Where do I start with this? What's the workflow here?
Which pro-dev skill should I use for this task?
I have a vague itch to build something but I don't know what I actually want yet.
Grill me on this idea before I commit to it.
I have a rough concept — show me a few different directions I could take it.
/adhd how should I design this API surface — run it under a bunch of different cognitive frames in parallel.
Write me a detailed implementation plan with a test-first breakdown before we code.
This is a client engagement — we need a written spec they can sign off on before any code.
Is my change actually working in the browser right now? Click through it for me.
Add a unit test for this React component.
Run the whole test suite and tell me what's failing.
I want to write a durable committed end-to-end regression suite for CI.
Before I tell the user this is done, double-check it really is.
The app keeps crashing on save — help me find the root cause.
Review my pull request and the diff on this branch.
note: boundary: a code-diff review is not the pro-design UI-change review

prompt: I'm executing an already-approved plan — drive the implementation across subagents.
Harden this endpoint against SQL injection and audit it for security holes.
Set up the database schema and migrations with Drizzle.
Do a full UI/UX pass on this dashboard and make it polished.
Render my plan as a reviewable HTML artifact I can annotate in the browser before we start building.
Generate a brand kit for my startup: logo concepts, a color system, typography, and a few product mockups.
Before we write any code, generate premium reference images for the marketing site hero and key sections.
Generate a landing page from this brief that does not look like every other templated AI-built site.
Add a revenue chart to the analytics dashboard page.
This paragraph reads like ChatGPT wrote it - make it sound human.
Create a new skill that captures our deploy checklist and measure how well it triggers.
I think this feature is finished. What do I need to check on my end before I sign off on it?
note: handing work back to a human is validation, not the agent's own verification

prompt: Give me a list of things to click through and confirm manually now that this has landed.
note: manual check list for the user

prompt: Run the test suite and confirm it actually passes before you claim this is done.
note: boundary: the agent's own evidence gathering must NOT route to the user handoff

prompt: Write release notes and a migration guide for the changes that just landed on this branch.
note: developer-facing prose from a real diff

prompt: The setup steps in our README don't work anymore - half the commands fail on a fresh clone.
note: drifted docs / broken onboarding path, not a code bug hunt

prompt: Document these REST endpoints: request and response shapes, auth scopes, and the error codes clients can expect.
note: consumer-facing API reference from the implementation

prompt: Go back through my recent sessions and fold what you learned into my project memory - the corrections I made, the decisions we settled on, the preferences I keep repeating.
note: consolidation across many transcripts, not saving one fact

prompt: Memory consolidation is due for this project - it has been over 24h since the last one. Run it and rebuild the MEMORY.md index.
note: phrased the way the SessionStart nudge phrases it

prompt: Remember that I always want the dev server on port 4000.
note: boundary: saving a single fact is the normal auto-memory path, not a consolidation pass

prompt: I'm building the settings screen for our app - components, empty and loading states, the whole thing. Make it look properly designed, not default.
note: start-here build of new product UI, not a redesign pass and not a marketing page

prompt: Design a landing page for our scheduling tool that actually converts - one clear call to action.
note: single-CTA conversion page

prompt: I want the marketing site to feel like an Awwwards winner - big immersive scroll storytelling, section by section.
note: immersive scroll-storytelling site

prompt: Add a custom cursor trail and a WebGL shader background to the hero, and turn this screen recording of a site I like into a prompt I can reuse.
note: specific effects plus video-to-superprompt from the Meng To library

prompt: Design this dashboard in the style of Linear, ground it in real reference sites rather than guessing, and score the result so I can iterate.
note: reference-grounded visuals with a style recipe and a score

prompt: Here is a screenshot I love - pull its exact palette and spacing out of the image and keep that style locked across every screen we build.
note: token extraction from a reference image's real pixels plus a project-wide style lock, not the anti-slop/brand-kit library

prompt: My site is already built. Add animations to it - work out what should move and what should stay still.
note: adding motion to an existing site, not defining a motion token scale or a GSAP marketing timeline

prompt: I want this to feel snappy but not bouncy. What does that actually mean in easing and duration terms?
note: vague motion words to exact animation terms

prompt: Make this screen follow Apple's design guidelines.
note: Apple HIG principles

prompt: Review the UI changes on this branch and tell me what regressed visually.
note: UI-change review over a diff with regression detection, not a code review

prompt: Critique this screenshot for me - what's wrong with the hierarchy and the spacing?
note: judge a rendered screen

prompt: Nothing lines up on this page. Fix the spacing and the alignment.
note: pixel-level spacing and alignment fixes

prompt: Users keep misreading which items belong together on this screen. Apply proper grouping principles.
note: Gestalt grouping and visual hierarchy; better-layout is defensible since the two cross-reference each other

prompt: Review this whole screen across accessibility, layout, typography, colour, and copy and give me one ranked verdict.
note: holistic consolidation across the better-* family into a single verdict
